'''Sawmill''' was a software package for the [[log analysis|statistical analysis]] and reporting of [[Logging (computing)|log files]]. Sawmill also incorporated real-time reporting and alerting. 

Sawmill supported approximately 850 server log file formats. It included a [[Web analytics#Page tagging|page-tagging]] server and a JavaScript [[page tag]] for analyzing client-side clicks (client requests), providing a  view of visitor traffic and on-site activity.

Sawmill Analytics was offered in three forms: a software package for user deployment, a system appliance for use on-premises, and an application for [[Software as a service|software as a service (SaaS)]]. Sawmill analyzed devices or software packages to produce a log file that included [[web server]]s, [[Firewall (computing)|firewalls]], [[proxy server]]s, [[Mail transfer agent|mail servers]], [[Computer network|network devices]], [[Syslog|syslog servers]], and [[database]]s.

Branded versions of Sawmill included ''Sawmill for IronPort'' by [[Cisco Systems]],<ref>[http://www.ironport.com/pdf/web_sec_mgmt_ds.pdf Cisco IronPort Web Security Appliance Management] contains description of Sawmill for IronPort.</ref> ''InterGate Intelligence'' by Vicomsoft Ltd,<ref>[http://www.vicomsoft.com/products/reporting/index.html Intergate Intelligence] contains a description of InterGate Intelligence, a rebranded version of Sawmill.</ref> and SonicWALL Aventail Advanced Reporting by [[SonicWALL]].<ref>[http://www.sonicwall.com/in/488_8564.html SonicWALL Aventail Advanced Reporting] contains a description of SonicWALL Aventail Advanced Reporting, a rebranded version of Sawmill.</ref>

Sawmill went out of business on 17 May 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |title=sawmill.net - Sawmill - Universal log file analysis and reporting |url=http://www.sawmill.net/blog/ |access-date=2024-02-07 |website=www.sawmill.net}}</ref>
